senses.gloss:
डी डी (akin to 1. दी, q. cf.), i. 1 and 4, Ātm. To fly.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. डिन, n. Flying, the flight of a bird, MBh. 8, 1899.
 --With the prep. [] अति अति, अतिडीन, n. Flying over, MBh. 8, 1900.
 --With अभि अभि, अभिडीन, n. Flying towards, MBh. 8, 1900.
 --With अव अव, अवडीन, n. Flying down, MBh. 8, 1899.
 --With उद् उद्, To fly up, Pañc. 106, 1. उड्डीन, Flown up, MBh. 7, 776. n.
 1. Flying up, MBh. 8, 1899.
 2. The flight of a bird, Pañc. 114, 25.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To fly up and away, Mṛcch. 84, 22. प्रोड्डीन, Flown up and away, Rām. 4, 63, 24.
 --With नि नि, निडीन, n. Flying down, MBh. 8, 1899.
 --With परा परा, परा-डीन, n. Flying away, MBh. 8, 1900.
 --With परि परि, परिडीन, n. Flying round, MBh. 8, 1900.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रडीन, Flown forth, Rām. 6, 83, 26; n. Flying forward, MBh. 8, 1899.
 --With वि वि, विडीन, n. Flying apart, MBh. 8, 1900.
 --With सम् सम्, संडीन, n. Flying together, MBh. 8, 1899.
 --With अवसम् अव-सम्, अवसंदीन, n. Flying down together, MBh. 8, 1901.
